title: Up Next
description: A music queue that plays: drag a song by its grip and the others part around it as it tilts with your hand, swipe a row left past the rubber band to drop it with an undo, and tap any song to fly its cover into the now-playing card with live bars.
intent: Every row is a physical card on one rail: reorder and remove are the same direct gesture, retargetable mid-move, with quiet ticks as rows swap.
